title: Commit current full-cook ledger state
objective: Inspect the current worktree and create a clean commit for all current meaningful local changes from the completed full-cook/ledger/test work before new feature development starts.
instructions: Inspect git status and diffs before committing.
Commit all meaningful local changes from the completed full-cook ledger/test/doc/state work so the subsequent feature starts from a clean baseline.
Use a clear commit message such as 'Record full ledger Linux package cook' unless the inspected diff suggests a better concise message.
If there are unrelated local changes that should not be included, report them and leave them uncommitted rather than guessing.
constraints: Do not rewrite history or use destructive git commands.
Do not include generated binaries or oversized package artifacts unless they are already intentionally tracked and modified.
expected_outputs: Commit hash and summary of committed files.
Remaining git status after commit, including any intentionally uncommitted files.
definition_of_done: Meaningful current local changes are committed and the worktree is clean except for intentionally uncommitted artifacts, or blockers are reported.
